description: Update a booking: project, price, is_quote, comments (print on the contract), manager_notes (internal, do not print), headcount (participants/volunteers), event type (project_type_id, applied to all its dates), deposit (whole percent 0-100), contact_id (which of the client's existing contacts the contract and signing/payment emails go to), and client_id to reassign the booking to a different client.

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

price.description: An amount in US dollars, e.g. 250 or 250.00.

name: update_booking
title: Update Booking
